notes: Each rule proposes a habit change for a category the user actually logged.
share is the fraction of last week's activity that a realistic person could move or cut. These are assumptions, not measurements.
The saving is calculated from the emission factor model, never written by the language model.

rules.title: Take the bus for some car trips
rules.action: Swap about {shifted} km of car driving a week for the bus, starting with a route you already know.

rules.title: Take the bus for some car trips
rules.action: Swap about {shifted} km of car driving a week for the bus, starting with a route you already know.

rules.title: Walk or cycle the short trips
rules.action: Walk or cycle about {shifted} km a week of short trips (under 2 to 3 km each) instead of taking the car.

rules.title: Walk or cycle the short trips
rules.action: Walk or cycle about {shifted} km a week of short trips (under 2 to 3 km each) instead of taking the car.

rules.title: Skip the bike for short hops
rules.action: Walk or cycle about {shifted} km a week of very short trips instead of starting the bike.

rules.title: Walk the short auto rides
rules.action: Walk or cycle about {shifted} km a week of short auto rides.

rules.title: Take the train where one exists
rules.action: Move about {shifted} km of flying a week to rail on routes with a decent train.

rules.title: Swap some beef meals
rules.action: Swap {shifted} of your beef or buffalo meals a week for a vegetarian option like dal, rajma or paneer.

rules.title: Swap some mutton meals
rules.action: Swap {shifted} of your mutton meals a week for a vegetarian option like chole or a vegetable curry.

rules.title: Make some chicken meals vegetarian
rules.action: Make {shifted} of your chicken meals a week vegetarian.

rules.title: Trim home electricity by about 10 percent
rules.action: Use about {shifted} kWh less a week: AC at 24 to 26 degrees, switch off standby devices, LED bulbs.

rules.title: Cook with less gas
rules.action: Use lids and a pressure cooker to save about {shifted} kg of LPG a week.

rules.title: Divert some waste from the bin
rules.action: Compost kitchen scraps and recycle dry waste to cut about {shifted} kg of general waste a week.

starter_tips.title: Log a few days first
starter_tips.message: Log your travel, electricity and meals for a few days and EcoPulse will point out where your biggest savings are.

starter_tips.title: Start with electricity
starter_tips.message: Home electricity is often the easiest place to begin. Set the AC to 24 to 26 degrees and switch off standby devices.

starter_tips.title: Try one veg day
starter_tips.message: Pick one day a week where every meal is vegetarian. It is a small change that adds up.
